title: Fire Near Reno, Nev., Prompts Evacuations of Homes and Hospitals
summary: The Hawk fire has burned over 13,000 acres and is encroaching on the northern part of the city. About 42,000 people are under formal evacuation orders and thousands more have been urged to flee.
